activity_summary: After the Shrew you reckoned a thin yard, apprentices with nothing to do, which was what Margery had said in the morning. The flag had been up. You had come by the fields. Phillips and Pope had come by boat, not by the Bridge. John named no sum. You named no share. You told them fourpence at Leadenhall, two hundred yards from home, and a loaf a thumb short. The aldermen's blame, which John had heard on Thursday, was said again, and the afternoon had not given the Mayor his sentence. You went home.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Reported the fields, the fourpence, and the thumb, and named no share.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Itemised the flag, the boat, and the thin yard, and refused a borrowed figure.

entities.name: Augustine Phillips
entities.context: Confirmed the boat, and called the house quiet enough to play in.

entities.context: Confirmed the boat, and refused a longer telling.

quotes.speaker: john_heminges
quotes.text: I have no figure for this afternoon that I am willing to say, and I will not borrow one.

quotes.speaker: margery_pell
quotes.text: Thin, as I said before the flag.
